summary: Normalize the case of a text value.
documentation: lower returns a new string with cased characters converted to lowercase. Characters without a lowercase mapping remain unchanged.
inputs: The string whose case should be normalized.
returns: A new string containing lowercase characters.
caution: lower is not the same as Unicode casefolding. This challenge uses ASCII input and preserves whitespace.
scenarios: Normalize a simple imported status field.
Prepare ASCII tags for case-insensitive comparison.
Create consistent labels from mixed-case input.
title: Normalize an ASCII status
problem: Return the input ASCII string in lowercase. Preserve spaces, digits and punctuation exactly.
goal: Use str.lower() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Use lower without trimming the text.
